preconditions.description: The length of the input array arr must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 30 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array arr must have a length between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array arr must be strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or (len(stdout) > 0 and all(stdout[:i] in arr for i in range(1, len(stdout) + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output must be either an empty string or the longest string whose all prefixes are present in the array.

postconditions.expression: any(len(s) == len(stdout) for s in arr)
postconditions.description: The output string must be the longest among all valid strings in the array.

postconditions.expression: stdout == min(s for s in arr if len(s) == len(stdout))
postconditions.description: If there are multiple longest strings, the output must be the lexicographically smallest one.
